turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes. Withdraw the zero, and then we'll talk about why my son found out from his phone in the middle of class.
Don't thank me. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in, or did you decide first?
I'm waiting, Hale. Did you speak to Owen before you entered that zero?
We're not here about the weather, Hale. Answer the question: was Owen heard before that zero went in?
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale. Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered. Nobody called me. Do you dispute that?
